sloka: ततो ऽतिकायो बलवान् प्रविश्य हरिवाहिनीम्।विस्फारयामास धनुर्ननाद च पुनःपुनः ।। ६.७१.३७ ।।
transliteration: tato 'tikāyo balavān praviśya harivāhinīm।visphārayāmāsa dhanurnanāda ca punaḥpunaḥ ।। 6.71.37 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, mighty Atikaya entered the monkey army, twanged his bow again and again and made a loud noise.
